_comment: Curated identity fixes, consulted before any network catalogue.
`works` maps titles and aliases onto a canonical film. Use it for festival
titles, rep-house programming, and anything TMDB has not indexed.
`pins` bind one venue product id straight to a work_id and always win.
That is the escape hatch for a product the heuristics get wrong every time -
e.g. a chain listing a film under a promotional name.
